scope: Remaining DOG FENCES/GATES source gap: does the City's distinct line/area asset dataset (not the point layer) carry actual fence lines, gate points, material/height, or a fenced flag for the Biidaasige off-leash areas?
method: Bounded primary-source search (<=10 min). Inspected the COTGEO_PFR_PARK_AMENITY FeatureServer (point-only) and the City mirror cot_geospatial13 FeatureServer line/area layers (Infrastructure polyline, Outdoor Recreation Area polygon, Park Amenity point). Queried Biidaasige by name, rollup, bbox and proximity; ran city-wide positive controls. No coordinates invented; no image pixels interpreted.
ownership: NEW files only: docs/biidaasige-fence-source.md and this fixture. Captain integrates. No runtime/amenity/dog-surface/shared-file edits, no GPU/full-suite/commits/bead-close.
captainCorrectionsPreserved: Dataset currency is NOT completeness. Absence in an asset layer does not prove a feature is absent.
City Recreation page (2026-09-09) and the first-hand blog assert the dog fences and accessible gates exist; that assertion stands.
Do not repeat the prior error of inferring absence from dataset absence.

conclusion.answer: No usable fence/gate geometry, material, height, width or positive fenced flag was found for the Biidaasige OLAs in the City line/area asset data. This is an honest negative, NOT proof of absence.
conclusion.status: exists per City prose; geometry not in the asset data
conclusion.reasoning: The area layer (34) confirms both OLAs as polygons but leaves FENCED_OR_BOARDED_IND null. The fence line layer (25) is a 24-feature legacy subset city-wide with no Biidaasige fence. The gate point layer (52) is large (4917 city-wide) but has zero Biidaasige gates. No material/height/width is published for the park.

services.result: Point-only. No line or area layers. Not the line/area dataset.

services.what: City mirror cot_geospatial13 FeatureServer (line & area layers)

notes: FENCED_OR_BOARDED_IND is null (not populated), not 'No' — cannot be read as unfenced.
City polygon is smaller than both OSM ring and published area, so it is a partial/representative footprint, not the whole OLA boundary.
OSM rings dogs-west-800 / dogs-east-1200 remain the authoritative whole boundaries.
No 'Outdoor Fitness Equipment Area' polygon exists at Biidaasige.

parkBboxFeature.note: At lat 43.651-43.653, north of the park; not the OLA.

infrastructureFenceLines.caveat: Only 24 fences city-wide — a partial/legacy inventory. Absence at Biidaasige is NOT evidence of no fence.

parkBboxFeatures: CHERRY BEACH CLARKE BEACH PARK - Gate (1..4)
gatePoints.caveat: Gate inventory is large and current, but no Biidaasige gate is recorded. No gate geometry/material/width is published for the park.

priorPassContext.osm: OSM fence/gate queries already negative for a usable OLA enclosure (not repeated). OLA whole boundaries exist: dogs-east-1200 (way/1418542004), dogs-west-800 (way/1419966624).
priorPassContext.ortho2025: Captain viewed dedicated dog-east/west ortho exports: pre-opening construction with turf/apron, no installed fence/usable gate. Cannot place a 2026 fence from a 2025 image.
priorPassContext.cityRecreation: City Recreation page (2026-09-09) explicitly states both OLAs are fenced with accessible gates.
priorPassContext.dogSurfaceWorker: A separate dog-surface worker is correcting apron/turf in a new module; not touched here.

whatWouldChangeTheAnswer: A populated FENCED_OR_BOARDED_IND = Yes on the layer-34 OLA polygons.
A Fence line feature (layer 25) or Gate point (layer 52) with ROLLUP_TO = BIIDAASIGE PARK.
A City construction/as-built or capital record with fence spec (material/height) and gate locations.
A current (2026) photo with GPS EXIF showing the installed fence and gate.
